name: Dürkheimer Advent
description: Advent market on four weekends in the Kurpark and old town
hours: Fri 16-21, Sat 12-21, Sun 12-20; from 2nd weekend also Thu 16-21
dateNote: weekends only: 27-29 Nov, 3-6, 10-13, 17-20 Dec (Thursdays only Römer- and Stadtplatz)
details:
The Dürkheimer Advent is open on the four Advent weekends. In the upper Kurpark: a Palatinate nativity scene in the concert shell, light installations and the "Weihnachtsmanufaktur" with makers changing every weekend. On the Römerplatz a yurt for children's crafts; in town Advent concerts and Palatinate dialect at the "Glühschoppen", ice stock sport, stick bread over the fire, mulled wine and food.

Friday 16-21, Saturday 12-21, Sunday 12-20; from the second weekend also Thursday 16-21 (only Römer- and Stadtplatz, subject to change).
